tbesh_html:
1) to wear out, become old
1a) (Qal) to wear out
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to wear out
1b2) to wear out by use, use up completely
1b3) to enjoy, use to the full
Aramaic equivalent: be.la (בְּלָא "to wear out" H1080)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to fail; by implication to wear out, decay (causatively, consume, spend)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: consume, enjoy long, become (make, wax) old, spend, waste.
